expectedSelectedVersionsBasis: Resolved by Go 1.26.6 using go list -mod=readonly -m -json all with the exact patched go.mod and native-expanded go.sum. The original upstream graph selects the same 1,159 paths; only the eight reviewed module versions differ. All 651 previously omitted selected modules and all 849 materialized checksum records belong to unchanged original upstream selections. Unknown, missing or moved selections remain rejected.
nativeAcceptanceRequirements: Every actual non-main selected module path/version exactly matches expectedSelectedVersions; no unknown path or alternate version is accepted
Every actual non-main module has exact content and go.mod sums from frozen go.sum; only the declared upstream replacement is allowed
Every expectedSelectedVersions entry appears at its declared version in the native selected graph
Original frozen go.mod and go.sum SHA256 remain unchanged after module download, list and build
Go checksum database stays enabled and go mod verify passes; downloaded module sums are authenticated before execution
Unknown selected versions, missing sums or graph drift fail before image execution; actual graph is retained as build evidence

nativeResolution.qualificationBoundary: Native module resolution on the declared host only. The image build still authenticates reviewed inputs and enforces the complete graph and frozen sums on native ARM64. Image build, scan, identity, provenance, signature and storage acceptance remain mandatory.
